'''Gray Five''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] used by the fifth member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Stealth Squadron|Gray Flight]] or the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Wraith Squadron|Gray Squadron]]. As this designation was used by both units, multiple [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] used the call sign Gray Five.

==History==
[[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] flew an [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] as Gray Five as part of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]{{'s}} [[Stealth Squadron|secret squadron]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SW3" />

[[Kell Tainer]] was the fifth member of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Wraith Squadron|Gray Squadron]] prior to the [[Squadron/Legends|squadron's]] adoption of its permanent designation, Wraith Squadron.<ref name="XWWS" />
